title: Atiyah–Sutcliffe determinant conjecture
statement: The normalized Atiyah–Sutcliffe determinant of every configuration of distinct points in R³ is nonzero.

counterexample.description: Give \(n\) distinct algebraic points in \(\mathbb R^3\) whose normalized determinant is zero. Exact number-field arithmetic directly verifies distinctness, directions, and the identity.
